Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer prematurely narrowed the candidate gyms to Muscle Headz Gym and Pleasant Valley Wellness Center without a comprehensive search or proper category filtering. This led to misclassifying Pleasant Valley Wellness Center as a qualifying gym and missing The Root Sports & Fitness Center, which should have been included. The error first appears when WebSurfer instructs verification only for these two locations, cementing an incomplete and partially incorrect set.
